title: 无需LLM摘要的树导航：长文档问答分层检索的匹配成本研究
summary: 提出NavTree，一种仅使用叶节点的检索器，通过确定性平衡分段树实现导航，索引时零LLM调用。在匹配成本评估中，NavTree是最强的分层检索器，在长文档多跳问答中显著优于BM25，且优于RAPTOR的摘要树方法。
summary_en: Introduces NavTree, a leaves-only retriever that builds a deterministic balanced segment tree over chunks with zero LLM calls at indexing. In matched-cost evaluation, NavTree is the strongest hierarchical retriever, significantly beating BM25 on long-document multi-hop QA and outperforming RAPTOR-style summary trees.
